title: What does an agent post when it finishes a round of work?
context: Agents work as usual, then post a summary to their thread. The orchestrator acts on it, the hub renders it, and it becomes part of the board's history.

options.name: Free text
options.sketch: <svg viewBox='0 0 320 180'><rect x='40' y='30' width='240' height='120' rx='6' fill='var(--muted)' fill-opacity='0.35' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='160' y='94' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Closing message</text></svg>

options.name: Fixed sections in text
options.summary: Done, changed, questions, decisions needed, blocked on, next step.
options.sketch: <svg viewBox='0 0 320 180'><rect x='40' y='20' width='240' height='26' rx='6' fill='var(--muted)' fill-opacity='0.35' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='160' y='37' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Done</text><rect x='40' y='50' width='240' height='26' rx='6' fill='var(--accent)' fill-opacity='0.85' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='160' y='67' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Questions</text><rect x='40' y='80' width='240' height='26' rx='6' fill='var(--accent)' fill-opacity='0.85' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='160' y='97' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Decisions needed</text><rect x='40' y='110' width='240' height='26' rx='6' fill='var(--muted)' fill-opacity='0.35' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='160' y='127' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Blocked on</text><rect x='40' y='140' width='240' height='26' rx='6' fill='var(--muted)' fill-opacity='0.35' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='160' y='157' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Next step</text></svg>
cons: The hub must parse text to render cards

options.name: Structured summary event
options.summary: The same sections posted as a structured event (questions, decisions with entry numbers, files changed), which the hub renders as a message with cards.
options.sketch: <svg viewBox='0 0 320 180'><rect x='20' y='30' width='130' height='120' rx='6' fill='var(--accent)' fill-opacity='0.85' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='85' y='94' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Summary event</text><line x1='150' y1='90' x2='168' y2='90' stroke='currentColor'/><polygon points='168,90 161.7,93.0 161.7,87.0' fill='currentColor'/><rect x='170' y='30' width='130' height='120' rx='6' fill='var(--muted)' fill-opacity='0.35' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='235' y='87' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Message</text><text x='235' y='101' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>with cards</text></svg>
pros: Questions and decisions render as real cards with buttons
cons: Agents need a tool or schema to post it

recommendation: With your own interface and an event log, a structured summary is what turns questions and decisions into cards you can act on.
